subject: Requested: scoped auth evidence & SOC 2 bridge for Starlit Health
messages:
From: Priya Sharma <security@starlithealth.com>
To: aisha.rahman@redwood.com
Cc: procure@starlithealth.com
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Starlit: scoped auth evidence request + SOC 2 bridge

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for taking this — procurement is holding on final sign-off pending a few artifacts beyond the SOC 2 Type II that we received earlier. Can your team provide the following by EOD next Thursday (2027-04-29)? If timeline is tight, let us know the earliest possible delivery.

Scope we need (concise):
- SOC 2 Type II report (we have vPDF but need confirmation of audit period and any scope exclusions)
- Signed bridge letter covering the current gap between report end date and the contract start date
- MFA enforcement evidence for privileged accounts (policy + enforcement log slice)
- Auth/session logs for the audit window (slices for 2026-09-01 -> 2027-03-31) with user identifier and event type
- Recent access review exports (privileged group review artifacts + approver attestations)
- Key rotation record for keystore used for signing tokens (high level + date of last rotation)

Preferred formats: CSV export for logs, PDF for approvals, and a short TXT/MD mapping that ties artifacts back to SOC 2 CC7 control objectives. If you have a secure upload (SFTP or presigned GCS) we can ingest there — otherwise we can accept a shared Drive link with appropriate permissions.

I attached an updated evidence request PDF with fields we need filled (starlit_evidence_request_v2.pdf). Also looping in procurement for timeline constraints.

Thanks,
Priya Sharma
Security Manager, Starlit Health
priya@starlithealth.com

-- attachment: starlit_evidence_request_v2.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <security@starlithealth.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Starlit: scoped auth evidence request + SOC 2 bridge

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear list and the PDF. We can provide everything you asked for; a few clarifying items so we scope exactly what you'll receive:

1) Audit period: our SOC 2 Type II covers 2026-01-01 -> 2026-12-31. We will include a bridge letter that covers the period from 2027-01-01 to the contract start date. If you need continuous attestation for 2026-12-31 -> 2027-04-01 specifically, confirm and we'll extend wording accordingly.

2) MFA evidence: do you need per-user verification events (every MFA success/failure) or a summarized enforcement export showing policy hits and enforcement outcomes for privileged roles? We can provide both but the raw per-event export is larger.

3) Upload: we prefer to deliver via a presigned GCS bucket. We can supply an encrypted bundle (AES-256) and a checksum. If Starlit requires SFTP instead, tell us the host and preferred public key.

I'll loop Karthik (security engineering) for the log slices and Olga for the bridge letter sign-off path. Targeting an initial delivery of the bridge letter + access review PDFs by 2027-04-23 and the log slices by 2027-04-28. Does that work?

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aisha.rahman@redwood.com

-- signature: Redwood Inference — Solutions Engineering

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: aisha.rahman@redwood.com
Cc: olga.petrov@redwood.com, Priya Sharma <security@starlithealth.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Starlit: scoped auth evidence request + SOC 2 bridge

Priya / Aisha — quick technical notes to confirm what we will produce and how we sanitize it: 

- Auth log slice: we can extract events with schema (timestamp, principal_id, event_type, ip, device_id, token_id, outcome). Delivery options: CSV + gzipped syslog text. We will redact full email addresses to user IDs (redwood_user_####) unless you require original identifiers — if so, please confirm data handling NDA scope.

- MFA evidence: we can provide a CSV of MFA events for privileged groups (group membership exported from our IDM) covering successes/failures and challenge types. Example row (attached as mfa_event_sample.csv): 2026-11-03T14:22:10Z, redwood_user_007, login_totp, success, us-west1

- Access reviews: we will export the “privileged_admins” review artifacts including reviewer name, decision, timestamp and attached comments (PDF). That will include approver attestations where available.

- Keystore rotation: we will supply a signed statement with the rotation dates and the KMS key alias used (no private material).

Secure upload: presigned GCS is fine. We will upload under folder: /starlit-evidence/STL-4432/ and provide a single AES-256 encrypted archive plus SHA256 checksum. If Starlit wants direct SFTP, provide host and key.

We will not include raw session payloads or PII — only identifiers and event metadata as discussed. Delivery timeline: bridge + reviews PDF by 2027-04-23, log + MFA slice by 2027-04-28.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

-- attachment: mfa_event_sample.csv (text/csv)

From: Priya Sharma <security@starlithealth.com>
To: aisha.rahman@redwood.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, procure@starlithealth.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Starlit: scoped auth evidence request + SOC 2 bridge

Thanks, Aisha and Karthik — this looks good and aligns with our needs. A few quick asks before you generate the archive: 

- Please use the audit window 2026-09-01 -> 2027-03-31 for the log slice (we are sampling for that period specifically).
- Provide the MFA per-event export (CSV) for privileged accounts — Starlit will ingest and run a small analytics job. If redaction is required, we can accept internal IDs as long as the mapping is included in a secure, separate file.
- For the bridge letter, can you include language that explicitly names Redwood Inference, references the SOC 2 Type II report (covering period 2026-01-01 -> 2026-12-31) and confirms no material changes in MFA, auth configuration, or key management since the report end date? Our procurement team also asked that the bridge letter be signed by an executive (security or CEO).

Upload: presigned GCS is preferred. We will share the bucket path after you confirm. Also, please attach checksums and let us know whether the encrypted bundle uses password-based encryption or a public-key envelope (we prefer public-key).

Procurement has also requested a completed line in the attached PDF requesting the DocuSign contract reference (deal id STL-4432). We'll add that on our side once the artifacts are uploaded.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Priya
Priya Sharma
Security Manager, Starlit Health

-- note: Starlit asked for presigned GCS path and public-key envelope preference
